bullets.text: Minister Kumar inaugurated completed project works worth Rs 1.08 crore in the Adyar zone, Chennai.
PMK president Anbumani Ramadoss alleged a massive scam regarding safeguards for the Pallikaranai marshland projects, and the office should monitor developments.
Residents blocked the Chennai-Tirupati road near Periyapalayam for 30 minutes due to a five-hour power outage, requiring administrative watch.
A crack on the Arani river bridge in Thiruvallur has caused public shock, and the office must inspect repair actions.
Severe traffic congestion was reported on the Velachery 100 Feet Road, and the local team should coordinate with traffic authorities.
District collector S. Kavitha and MLAs launched the Vetri vegetable bundle scheme at affordable prices in Thiruvallur.
Police arrested three Andhra men and solved a house burglary case in Pallipattu involving stolen gold sovereign after a year.
Tamil Nadu won three medals with nine players participating in the World Arm Wrestling Championship held in Ponneri.
Tamil Nadu partnered with IIT Madras to sign an MoU establishing a new artificial intelligence data center.
MeitY approved 12 projects under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme with an estimated investment of Rs 7,503 crore.
The Tamil Nadu government constituted a 20-member Investment Promotion Commission headed by the Chief Secretary to drive Free Trade investments.
TVK IT Wing raised questions against the DMK regarding book purchases at the Periyar Arivalayam, prompting the office to track political discourse.
TVK IT Wing released government order documents regarding Phoenix publication book purchase orders to counter the DMK.
Kerala Law Academy invited papers for its 33rd international seminar on good governance and artificial intelligence in the digital era.
